current_state: Verbal intent only. Industry/DOE officials have stated a regasification facility may eventually be sited 'somewhere in Visayas or Mindanao', but no specific sponsor, no site selection, and no concrete step. Inter-island pipeline difficulty is driving interest toward small-scale/virtual-pipeline solutions rather than a discrete terminal.
missing_threshold_elements: Sponsor (none named); Location (no site selected, only 'Visayas or Mindanao'); Concrete step (no MOU/FEED/permit/site lease).
watch_for: A named sponsor + a specific port/site in Visayas or Mindanao, or a DOE permit-to-construct/notice-to-proceed application for an inter-island regas hub.
notes: Context: as of Oct 2025 the Philippines is in LNG-import oversupply (Batangas Bay cluster of operating + construction + proposed terminals), so DOE signals it is unlikely to add new terminals near-term. AG&P's 'virtual LNG pipeline' (small-scale distribution via vessels + mini-regas) is a delivery concept, not a discrete new terminal, and is not stageable. Re-check 6-12 months.
